jcr:title: Stryker Mobility Zone Makes Eighth Tour Stop of 2016 at DICK'S Sporting Goods Open

text.text:
MAHWAH, N.J., July 7, 2016 /PRNewswire/ -- Stryker Orthopaedics announces its eighth tournament stop of 2016 at the DICK'S Sporting Goods Open. Beginning on Thursday, the company will bring the Stryker Mobility Zone, the premiere on-site activation, to En-Joie Golf Course - located in the heart of the Susquehanna River Valley. Through the Stryker Mobility Zone, Stryker will continue its efforts to enhance the golf fan experience by educating tournament goers on the importance of joint health through engaging and interactive initiatives.

As the Official Joint Replacement Products of the PGA TOUR and PGA TOUR Champions, Stryker is committed to promoting joint health through the Stryker Challenge – a collection of golf-related activities located within the Stryker Mobility Zone. The Stryker Challenge allows each participant to test their own joint health and mobility and fans also have the opportunity to win a trip for two to TPC® Sawgrass to play alongside former PLAYERS Championship winners and longtime Stryker ambassadors, Fred Funk and Hal Sutton. 1, 2
